title: Extend Go web app in 2 steps: POST /api/items then DELETE /api/items/{id}
description: A Go web app with read-only item endpoints evolves in two steps to support create and delete.

task_spec.prompt:
The Go web app in internal/handler/items.go has GET / (HTML) and GET /api/items (JSON with ?q= filter). Extend it in two steps:

Step 1 — POST /api/items:
  Accept JSON body {"name": string, "price": float64}. Validate that name is non-empty and price >= 0. Return 400 for invalid input. Assign a new auto-incrementing ID, append to Store, return 201 with the created item as JSON. Write TestCreateItem (valid body, 201) and TestCreateItemBadRequest (empty name, 400).

Step 2 — DELETE /api/items/{id}:
  Extract the ID from the URL path. Return 404 if not found. Remove item from Store and return 200 with {"deleted": true}. Write TestDeleteItem (found, 200) and TestDeleteItemNotFound (missing, 404). Register both routes in cmd/server/main.go.

All 3 existing tests must still pass. Run go test ./... to confirm. Run go build ./... to confirm.
followup_prompts: Good progress. Run `go test ./...` to see where we stand. Continue with the remaining steps, prioritizing the parts the tests depend on most.
Final push: run `go test ./...` and fix any remaining failures. Make sure the full implementation is complete and all tests pass.
